purpose: Deterministically generate candidate-blind participant questions from frozen gate/channel catalogs. No participant answer may create or rewrite a construct.
rules: Never show Human Design vocabulary, gate numbers, channel numbers, planets, chart sides, or the predicted pole before reveal.
Ask repeated patterns, not isolated memorable events.
Always preserve Other / context-dependent free text and encourage it whenever fixed choices are imperfect.
Record childhood pattern, current pattern, contexts, exceptions, and counterexamples separately.
For less-conscious/body-side predictions, rely more on repeated behavior and independent observations from close others than on self-labels.
Do not treat lack of a chart predicate as a prediction that the behavior is absent; non-carrier states are neutral for that item.
A clear non-endorsement may contradict only states that positively predict the item, subject to measurement reliability.
Adaptive selection may choose among frozen items by candidate split utility but may not invent new item wording or mappings.
Keep North/South Node claims outside the primary natal trait score; they belong to the separate environment/perspective research layer.

planet_gate_items.predicate: activation gate at exact side/body equals gate

adaptive_selection.primary_utility: weighted binary structural split entropy among currently plausible candidate states
adaptive_selection.burden_rule: Prefer one focused construct at a time; use followups only when needed to resolve context or contradiction.
adaptive_selection.scientific_note: Structural split utility is an engineering diagnostic, not evidence that the construct is true.
